children.html: Chicken ragoût on a half shell - as an appetizer - Ragoût na mušlich

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • Chicken ragoût
  • • 4 tablespoons butter
  • • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan
  • • 1/2 cup bread crumbs
  • • 12 shells

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Butter the shells, fill each little over half full with chicken ragoût, sprinkle with grated Parmesan, bread crumbs and melted butter. Bake at 400F about 15 minutes or until golden on top.

children.html: Roast turkey - Krocan pečený

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 1 turkey, 15 lbs.
  • • 8 tablespoons (1 stick) butter
  • • 2 cups chicken broth
  • • 2 slices bacon
  • • salt

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Rinse turkey with cold water, and pat dry inside and out with paper towel.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Rub the body and neck cavities with salt and butter. Brush skin with butter.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Preheat oven to 350F.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Pour one cup chicken broth in a roasting pan. Place the bird in the pan, breast down. Roast, uncovered 1-1/2 hours, basting occasionally with butter, chicken broth and pan drippings.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Turn turkey breast up, place 2 slices bacon on top and roast 1-1/2 – 2 hours, basting with the remaining butter, chicken broth and juices from the pan.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: When done, transfer the bird on a heated platter. Strain the pan drippings, discarding all fat, and pour some over the turkey. Serve the remaining juice in a saucedish. For easier carving allow turkey to stand 10-15 minutes.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serve with potatoes, salad, vegetables, compote.

children.html: Serves 15 – Preparation time: 3 hours 30 minutes

children.html: Stuffed turkey - Krocan nadivaný

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Prepare the bird as indicated in "roast turkey". Turn the neck into the body cavity to block the passage between the neck and the body. The stuffing will stay in the neck cavity while roasting. Lightly fill neck cavity with stuffing. Do not pack - stuffing will expand while cooking. Fasten neck skin with stitches or skewer. Roast turkey as shown above.

  • • 1 cup milk or water

  • • 1/2 cup bread crumbs
  • • salt, marjoram, thyme

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Soak the rolls in milk or water, squeeze off excess liquid, shred them. Rinse and finely chop the giblets.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: In a bowl cream butter, eggs, add the chopped onion, thyme, marjoram, shredded rolls, giblets, bread crumbs. Salt the mixture and mix thoroughly.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Simmer chestnuts in water for 10-15 minutes. When the shells crack, peel and chop them coarsely.

children.html: Break the rolls, soak them in milk, squeeze off excess, shred them. In a bowl cream butter, one whole egg and three egg yolks. Add the shredded rolls, nutmeg, sugar and coarsely chopped chestnuts. Salt the mixture; Fold in half of the bread crumbs and three stiffly whipped egg whites.

children.html: Stuffed pigeon - Holub nadivaný

children.block_description: The header of a section of text or other blocks.
children.html: Prepare stuffing first:

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 3 young pigeons
  • • 6 tablespoons butter
  • • salt
  • • 3/4 cup chicken stock

children.block_description: The header of a section of text or other blocks.
children.html: Stuffing:

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 4 and 2 tablespoons butter (2. tbsp for braising the liver)
  • • 2 egg yolks
  • • 1 egg white
  • • 2 hard baked rolls
  • • 1/2 cup milk
  • • liver from three pigeons, chopped
  • • parsley
  • • 1/2 cup bread crumbs
  • • salt

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Soak the rolls in milk, squeeze off excess, shred them. Cream the butter and the egg yolks, add the shredded rolls, the liver sautéed in butter, salt, snipped parsley, bread crumbs. Add stiffly whipped egg white.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Carefully loosen the skin of the breasts and fill the pockets with stuffing. Enclose with stitches.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Salt the pigeons. Place them in a roasting pan with melted butter, breasts down, roast at 350F for 20 minutes.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Baste with melted butter, juices from the pan and a little chicken stock.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Turn pigeons breasts up and finish roasting in the same manner.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: To serve, cut the pigeons in halves, sprinkle with pan drippings and snipped parsley. (Remove the stitches, of course).

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serve with potatoes, green peas, salad, etc.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serves 6 - Preparation time: 1 hour

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 1 goose, 10 lbs.
  • • 4-5 medium apples
  • • salt, caraway seeds
  • • water

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Rinse goose, pat dry. Rinse the apples do not peel them. Rub the goose inside and out with salt and caraway seeds. Fill body cavity with apples.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Place goose in a roasting pan with a little hot water at the bottom.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Roast at 350F, first breast side down for 1-1/2 hrs, basting with water and pan drippings. When golden brown on top, turn goose breast side

children.html: up. Continue roasting for 1-1/2 hours. While roasting, prick the skin with a fork over the fatty areas to release fat. (Just the skin, not the meat. If the juice from the meat runs out, the goose will become dry.) Total roasting time is approximately 20 minutes per pound. During the last 15 minutes of roasting, raise oven temperature to 400F and stop basting to achieve a crunchy skin. Remove apples and slice goose. Skim fat from pan juices and pour into a gravy boat to accompany goose. Serve with dumplings, potato dumplings, cabbage, red cabbage, sauerkraut.

children.html: Roast duck - Kachna pečená

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 1 duck (approx 8 lbs.)
  • • 4 tablespoons butter
  • • salt, caraway seeds

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html:
Roast the duck in the same manner as the goose. Do not stuff with apples.
While roasting, baste often with butter.

children.html: Duckling with Madeira wine - Kachna na vině

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 1 duckling, 5-6 lbs.
  • • 5 slices ham, cut in stripes
  • • 8 tablespoons butter
  • • 1 cup Madeira wine
  • • 1 cup chicken stock
  • • 3 tablespoons flour
  • • salt and pepper

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Rinse duckling, pat dry. Sprinkle with salt and pepper inside and out. Melt butter in a roasting pan, add ham and duckling. Brown it quickly on both sides under the broiler. Lower oven temperature to 350F. Pour Madeira wine over duckling. Add some of the chicken stock, salt and pepper, and cover with buttered waxpaper. Roast 1 to 1-1/2 hours, occasionally adding the remaining chicken stock.

children.html: Rabbit with paprika sauce - Králik na paprice

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 1 rabbit, 4.5 lbs., skinned, cleaned, cut in pieces
  • • 3 slices bacon, cut in strips
  • • 1/3 cup vegetable oil
  • • 1 small onion, finely chopped
  • • 3 tablespoons paprika
  • • 6 grains each of whole allspice and black peppercorns
  • • thyme, 2 bay leaves
  • • 3 tablespoons flour
  • • 2 cups chicken stock
  • • 1.1/2 cups sour cream
  • • salt

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Rinse, pat dry rabbit pieces. Sprinkle with salt and lard each with bacon strips.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Heat oil in a large pan; add onion and cook until translucent. Add paprika, whole allspice, black peppercorns, thyme, bay leaves and rabbit pieces.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Simmer, covered, for 1.1/2 hours, or until rabbit is tender, adding chicken stock when needed.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Using a slotted spoon, lift rabbit pieces from liquid and place in a casserole.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Stir flour into the liquid and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes. Add remaining chicken stock and sour cream and cook, stirring as necessary, until sauce is reduced to desired consistency, about 5 minutes. Strain sauce over rabbit. Simmer until heated through.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serve with gnocchi, dumplings, noodles.

children.html: Serves 6 – Preparation time: 2 hours

children.html: Fried rabbit - Králik smažený

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 1 rabbit, 4-5 lbs., skinned, cleaned, cut in small serving portions
  • • 2 eggs, whole
  • • 1/4 cup milk
  • • 3/4 cup flour
  • • 1-1/2 cups bread crumbs
  • • 1 cup vegetable oil for frying
  • • salt

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Scald rabbit with hot water, pat dry. Pound each piece lightly, sprinkle with salt. Dredge each in flour shaking off excess, dip in mixture of beaten eggs and milk, coat with bread crumbs. Fry in hot oil until golden, about 5 minutes each side. Drain on paper towel. Serve with salad, vegetables, potatoes.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serves 6 – Preparation time: 45 minutes

children.html: Roast hare (or wild rabbit) - Zajic pečený

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • Hindquarters of 1 hare, 4-5 lbs., cleaned, membrane removed
  • • 3 slices bacon, cut in short strips (1")
  • • 1 medium onion, finely chopped
  • • 8 tablespoons butter
  • • 1-2 cups beef stock
  • • salt and pepper

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Rinse, pat dry hare. Lard meaty side with bacon strips, sprinkle with salt and pepper. Melt butter in a roasting pan, add onion and the hare. Roast at 350F for 45 minutes, larded side down. Turn hare larded side up and roast 30-40 minutes or until tender. Baste frequently with beef stock and juices from the pan. Cut hare in serving portions. Serve with pan juices, fried potatoes, noodles, vegetables.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serves 6 – Preparation time: 1-2 hours

children.html: Hare in cream sauce - Zajic na smetanë

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • Hindquarters of 1 hare, 4-5 lbs., cleaned, membrane removed
  • • 3 slices bacon cut in short strips
  • • 1 medium onion, finely chopped
  • • carrot, celery, parsnip – sliced
  • • 5 grains each of black peppercorn, whole allspice, juniper berries
  • • thyme, bay leaf, ground nutmeg
  • • 6 tablespoons butter
  • • 1-1/2 cups beef stock
  • • 1-1/2 cups heavy cream
  • • juice of 1-2 lemons
  • • 3 tablespoons flour
  • • salt and pepper

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Rinse the hare, pat dry. Rub with crushed juniper berries, sprinkle with salt, lard with bacon strips.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Melt butter in a heavy skillet, add onion and vegetables, and sauté over medium heat.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: When onion is translucent, add hare and brown evenly on all sides.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Transfer all into a roaster. Add spices and some of the beef stock.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Roast 1 hour at 350F larded side down, then turn hare larded side up and continue roasting until tender, about 1 hour. Baste frequently with pan juices and beef stock.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Remove hare to carving board.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Make sauce by combining pan juices with flour. Simmer 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Add juice of 1 lemon and cream. Simmer a little more. Season to taste with salt, pepper and more lemon juice, if needed. Strain.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: To serve, slice hare and place slices on a warmed platter. Pour sauce over top.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serve remaining sauce in a gravy boat.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serve with rice, noodles, vegetables.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serves 6 – Preparation time: 2 hours 30 minutes

children.html: Marinated hare in wine sauce - Zajic na černo

children.block_description: The header of a section of text or other blocks.
children.html: Marinade:

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 1 cup sliced carrots
  • • 1 cup sliced onions
  • • 1 cup sliced shallots
  • • 3 cloves garlic, crushed
  • • 10 black peppercorns
  • • 3 bay leaves
  • • thyme
  • • 1/4 cup cognac
  • • 3 cups red wine
  • • 1-1/2 cups vegetable oil

children.block_description: The header of a section of text or other blocks.
children.html: Hare and sauce:

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • Front part of 1 hare, 4-5 lbs.
  • • 4 tablespoons butter
  • • 3 oz. bacon, diced
  • • 1 medium onion, chopped
  • • 3 tablespoons vinegar
  • • 1-1/2 cups beef stock
  • • 1 cup red wine
  • • grated rind of 1 lemon
  • • 5 grains each of black peppercorns and whole allspice
  • • 2 bay leaves, thyme
  • • 4 tablespoons flour
  • • 2 tablespoons brown sugar
  • • 1/4 cup cranberry sauce
  • • salt and pepper

children.block_description: The header of a section of text or other blocks.
children.html: To marinate:

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Place hare in a large crock. Add all dry ingredients, top with cognac, add wine.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Add oil to seal air out. The hare must be submerged in the marinade. Soak hare overnight, or even better 2-3 days.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Remove and wipe dry with a cloth.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Heat butter in a 4 quart top-of-range casserole. Add bacon and onion and cook until soft. Add all spices and lemon rind. Sprinkle hare with salt and vinegar, put into casserole, and brown lightly on all sides.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Reduce heat. Add some of the beef stock.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Cover tightly and simmer 1-1-1/2 hours, or until meat is tender when pierced with a fork. Add beef stock occasionally.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Transfer hare to a heated platter.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Skim off fat from the cooking liquid, stir in the flour and continue cooking to a rich brown. Add the remaining beef stock and the wine.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Cook until sauce thickens. Strain, blend in sugar and cranberry sauce. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Bring to boil, stirring constantly.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Slice hare, pour hot sauce over top.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serve with noodles, gnocchi, dumplings.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serves 6 – Preparation time: 2 hours, plus marinating

children.html: Venison cutlets, or medallions - Srnči žebírka

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 12 young venison cutlets, or medallions, 3 oz. ea.
  • • 12 juniper berries, crushed
  • • 4 tablespoons cognac
  • • salt and pepper
  • • 1·1/2 cups sour cream
  • • 1/2 cup chicken broth
  • • 3/4 cup olive oil
  • • 4 tablespoons butter
  • • 1 small onion, finely chopped
  • • 1 lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced lengthwise
  • • snipped parsley

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Trim excess fat from the cutlets, pound them lightly, rub with juniper berries, sprinkle with salt and pepper, drizzle with cognac and olive oil. Cover, marinate at least 1 hour.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Meanwhile melt butter in a large skillet, sauté onion and mushrooms. Season with salt and pepper. Reserve.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Drain and wipe the cutlets, reserve marinade. Heat remaining oil in a heavy frying pan, fry venison over high heat, about 3 minutes each side. Remove cutlets, keep them warm. Deglaze pan with marinade. Add chicken broth and sour cream, simmer 5 minutes. Taste for salt and pepper.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Coat the cutlets, or medallions, with the sauce. Garnish with mushrooms, snipped parsley, poached halves of apples, serve with noodles, rice.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serves 6 – Preparation time: 20 minutes, plus marinating

children.html: Roast pheasant - Bažant pečený

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 1 pheasant
  • • 2 slices bacon cut in short strips
  • • 6 tablespoons butter
  • • 1 medium onion, finely chopped
  • • 3·4 tablespoons flour
  • • 1·1/2 cups chicken broth
  • • salt and pepper

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Rinse and wipe the pheasant inside and out. Lard the breast and thighs with bacon strips. Brown the pheasant evenly all around in a frying pan in half of the butter and onion. Preheat oven to 350F. Transfer pheasant, breast down, into an ovenproof deep dish together with the butter and onion from the frying pan. Add salt and pepper. Roast 30·40 minutes, until the top gets reddish. Baste often with the remaining butter and chicken broth. Turn the bird breast side up, continue roasting in the same manner, 40-45 minutes.
